item.description: Kratmachos #1162 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.description: Kratmachos #1162 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to Iolcus. Only fire unmakes the Sown. Kratmachos is the silent now.
